text: oneil: "Over 70% above ma200, near 10% past the pivot." In my position system distance from the average is not a fault: buying strength above resistance is the entry (C26), confirmed here by TIF and COM (C28) with top-decile rank (C23). "Never buy the extension" is a swing rule (C3) and does not apply to this picture. My exits are the only two the method sanctions: a close below support 16.08, or the trend-colour flip, a red bar after the run, sold next session under its low (C14, C29). I hold SUPPORT. I drop it on elder_pattern leaving ACCELERATION before a fill.
